analysis: The supplied units are BASE-side excerpts of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (lines 805-1726). The only change in the file is a one-line documentation addition in the env-var table (head line 1960): DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS, which points to SSDPrefixCachePolicy.incrementalCheckpoints and describes an off switch (0/false/no/off) that writes complete checkpoints instead of deltas. This is documentation only and changes no code, so there is no direct security regression. It relates to T-041 (SSD prefix cache at-rest artifacts, SEC-035). Open question for integration: the underlying source change that adds incremental/delta checkpoints was not supplied here. It should be checked that delta blocks keep the same HMAC-only lookup tags, cacheSalt scoping, AAD binding, 30-minute TTL and KEK-wipe purge, and add no prompt-derived plaintext metadata. T-041's detection_hint says any change to SSDBlockStore metadata, the AAD or name derivation needs review. The T-041 threat model may also need a note on incremental checkpoint chains (delta dependency, partial chain eviction). The base excerpts I reviewed cover the status, doctor, benchmark, update, logout/unenroll and addon docs. They are unchanged and already-documented behavior, so I raise no new issues from them. Coverage is limited to docs; the code behind the new variable was not provided.
